newsitem.title: USA: CIENA enters pact with Digital Teleport.
newsitem.headline: CIENA enters pact with Digital Teleport.

text.p: CIENA Corp said on Tuesday it has signed a contract to supply Digital Teleport Incorporated, of St. Louis, with CIENA's MultiWave 1600 system in Digital Teleport's new long distance fiberoptic route.
Delivery and installation for the St. Louis-Kansas City fiberoptic route are scheduled for completion in the third quarter, the company said.
Dollar terms of the deal were not disclosed.
CIENA is a supplier of systems that increase fiber bandwidth and improve network reliability for telecommunications carriers with fiberoptic systems.
